notes: Data drawn directly from RME's official Digiface Dante User's Guide (rme-audio.de/downloads/dface_dante_e.pdf), sections 5.1 "Connectors – LEDs" and 24 "Technical Specifications", cross-checked against rme-audio.de/digiface-dante.html and the Sound on Sound review. Desktop unit, not rack-mountable (no rackUnits set). The two BNC sockets are physically shared/switchable between MADI I/O and Word Clock I/O per RME's own wording ("2 BNC sockets for word or MADI I/O") — modeled here as 4 logical ports (MADI In/Out, Word Clock In/Out) since the manual's Technical Specifications section documents distinct electrical specs for each function; in practice only one function (MADI or Word Clock) is active on the BNC pair at a time, firmware-switchable. USB port confirmed as Type-B (not Type-C) via Sound on Sound review and RME forum discussion of USB-B-to-C cables; grade usb-5g corresponds to USB 3.0 SuperSpeed (5 Gbit/s). Ethernet grade eth-1g per RME spec "100 Mbit/s, 1 Gbit/s" (1G is the higher/rated speed). Power adapter voltage cited as "DC 12 V 24W" in the manual's Package Contents section and "9-15 Volts DC" in Sound on Sound's independent teardown — noted as a minor discrepancy between RME's own manual and third-party review, likely reflecting the PSU's actual acceptance range vs. its nominal rating; used dc-barrel as the closest connector id for RME's proprietary locking coaxial DC connector. No rack ears; desktop/portable form factor (170 x 26 x 84 mm).

ports.name: Ethernet 1
ports.note: Primary Dante network port; supports 100 Mbit/s and 1 Gbit/s, Auto MDI-X; also used for TotalMix Remote

ports.name: Ethernet 2
ports.note: Secondary Dante network port (switched or redundancy mode)

ports.name: MADI In
ports.note: Coaxial MADI input, 75 Ohm, AES10-1991; up to 64ch/48kHz, S/MUX up to 16ch/192kHz; BNC socket shared/switchable with Word Clock function

ports.name: MADI Out
ports.note: Coaxial MADI output, 75 Ohm, AES10-1991, 400mVpp; BNC socket shared/switchable with Word Clock function

ports.name: Word Clock In
ports.note: Not terminated (10 kOhm), switchable internal 75 Ohm termination; shares physical BNC with MADI, switchable

ports.name: Word Clock Out
ports.note: Max 5 Vss; shares physical BNC with MADI, switchable

ports.name: Phones
ports.note: Low-impedance analog stereo output, unbalanced, usable as line output with TRS-to-RCA/TS adapter

ports.name: USB 3.0
ports.note: USB 3.0 SuperSpeed Type-B port to host computer; also carries USB bus power; falls back to USB 2.0 (64ch Dante only) if connected to a USB2 port

ports.name: DC In
ports.note: External locking DC power supply input (12V, included switched PSU rated 24W); device can alternatively run on USB bus power
